test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3,'** i.e.** "on"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this context, the word following the blank is** 'Monday',** which is a day of the week. 
 
• When we refer to doing something on a specific day, we use the preposition **'on'. **

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"At" **(Option 1) is a preposition that is generally used to point out specific time or place. However, it is not used with days of the week, and therefore is incorrect in this context.
 
• **"Through"** (Option 2) is a preposition used to describe movement within an area or a space, or duration over a period of time. It does not fit the context here.
 
• **"Over" **(Option 4) is a preposition used to show movement from one place to another, or covering or extending across a space or time. However, it does not fit logically in this context.
